description: This file defines a mock class ServiceMock for unit testing, which implements interfaces WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell and WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell::ICOMLink using Google Mock. It declares mock methods for various interface functions, facilitating testing of components that depend on these interfaces.
